Job Summary

We are seeking a visionary Automation Senior Cloud Solution Architect to lead the technical design and implementation of this transformative capability. This role is pivotal in architecting a scalable, AI-driven solution that seamlessly integrates advanced data processing, intuitive web interfaces, and intelligent automation.

This position demands a strategic leader who thrives in complexity and is deeply committed to cultivating strong stakeholder relationships. You will play a key role in fostering a culture of innovation and collaboration, guiding cross-functional teams to deliver solutions that drive pricing transparency, operational efficiency, and market competitiveness.

The ideal candidate will bring a unique blend of technical depth and strategic foresight, with a proven track record of leveraging cutting-edge technologies to deliver end-to-end automation at scale. The role with interface with Enterprise Architecture, Business leaders, Senior Leaders and Cyber/Privacy/Legal teams.


Key Responsibilities:

• Champion Software Excellence & Talent Development. Promote strong SDLC practices including clean architecture, automated testing, and scalable design. Mentor junior developers through code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative learning to foster a high-performing engineering culture.

• Lead Automation use cases architecture using technologies like GenAI, API, D&A, etc, working closely with Product Managers, automation engineers and stakeholders across business and DTS, and Enterprise Architecture.

• End-to-End Platform Development. Build and maintain front-end (React, TypeScript, Next.js) and back-end (Python, FastAPI, Node.js) layers that support GenAI workflows and agentic interactions.

• API & Agent Framework Integration. Design robust REST and GraphQL APIs for real-time agent communication, tool execution, and memory handling. Integrate frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and vector databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Chroma, Weaviate).

• ETL & Data Pipeline Architecture. Architect and optimize ETL pipelines for real-time and batch data processing. Ensure seamless data flow between GenAI services, databases, and user interfaces.

• Cloud-Native Deployment & Monitoring. Deploy and scale services using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines. Apply MLOps best practices for monitoring, versioning, and performance tuning of AI components.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration. Work closely with AI researchers, product managers, and delivery teams to align technical execution with strategic goals. Participate in multi-agent orchestration experiments and rapid prototyping cycles.


Key Qualifications and Experiences:

Technical Expertise:

• Cloud Platform Proficiency: Solid experience (minimum 5 years) in architecting, deploying, and managing applications across leading cloud platforms, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of cloud services including computing, database management, application development, and integration services. Familiarity with cloud-native services (Azure), containerization (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes), and serverless architectures is highly valued.

• Embedded Systems and CI/CD: Experience with embedded devices, operating systems, and server-client architecture. Proficient in CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.

• Architecture Design: Experience in Microservices and Event-Driven Architecture. Understanding architecture design principles and patterns. Experience with SQL Server, Web Services (SOAP/REST) and API development.

• .NET Development Skills: Extensive hands-on experience in building scalable, high-performance applications using .NET technologies, with strong capabilities in C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET, and Entity Framework. Knowledge of web technologies and frameworks, such as Blazor or ASP.NET MVC, is also crucial.

• Integration with SAP and Salesforce: Demonstrated ability to integrate .NET applications with both SAP and Salesforce platforms, employing APIs and middleware solutions like SAP Process Orchestration or API to facilitate robust data exchange and streamline workflows across these systems.

• Security and Compliance: Deep understanding of security practices related to cloud-hosted applications, including implementing secure authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., OAuth, OpenID Connect) and ensuring compliance with relevant industry security standards.

• Scalability and High Availability: Proven expertise in designing applications that are highly scalable and resilient, leveraging cloud scalability features such as load balancing, auto-scaling, and caching services to ensure optimal performance and availability.

• Agile Development Practices: Strong background in Agile methodologies, adept at managing product backlogs, user stories, sprint planning, and releases, particularly within a cloud-hosted application development environment.

• Strategic Problem Solving and Analytical Thinking: Ability to address complex technical and integration challenges with a strategic mindset, utilizing analytical and data-driven decision-making to optimize the application's performance and capabilities.


Specialized Skills:

• Prototyping: Ability to engage in rapid prototype development using iterative techniques.

• Vendor and Partner Engagement: Direct experience managing relationships with outsourcing and consulting partners.

• Cloud Architecture Design: Deep understanding of cloud solutions and architectures, enabling scalable, flexible, and resilient digital infrastructures that support rapid innovation and development.


Soft Skills and Others:

• Agile Collaboration: Demonstrated experience in effectively working with Agile and Product teams, including involvement with epics, user stories, sprints, and backlog management. The ability to collaborate closely with product owners, engineers, and scrum master’s to foster a productive and agile environment.

• Leadership in Communication and Reporting: Skilled in leading communication efforts and reporting, adept at preparing and presenting comprehensive updates and reports to senior leaders and stakeholders. Ability to succinctly highlight key metrics, progress, and insights, ensuring transparency and alignment at all levels of the organization.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Background in coordinating hardware & software development teams and business owners, with the ability to influence SMEs directly.

A Diretoria do CSVP torna pública a abertura de inscrições e a realização do Processo Seletivo de docentes para atuação na Educação Infantil, nos anos iniciais e finais do Ensino Fundamental e no Ensino Médio, em sua sede, no Cosme Velho, por meio de prova objetiva, prática e avaliação de currículo, a ser realizado no período que se estende pelos meses de outubro e novembro.


Processo seletivo simplificado

Destina-se à formação de cadastro de candidatos para ministrar aulas presenciais aos estudantes da Educação Infantil, dos Anos Iniciais e Finais do Ensino Fundamental e do Ensino Médio do CSVP, para o ano letivo de 2026.


Requisitos:


Habilitação


Para Educação Infantil e Anos Iniciais do Ensino Fundamental, os portadores de diploma de:

a) Curso Normal Superior;

b) Licenciatura em Pedagogia / Pedagogia para atuação na Educação Infantil e Anos Iniciais do Ensino Fundamental

c) Habilitação Específica para o Magistério e Diploma do Curso Normal de Nível Médio;

d) Programa Especial de Formação Pedagógica Superior, qualquer que seja a nomenclatura do Curso, com habilitação em Magistério da Educação Infantil e dos Anos Iniciais do Ensino Fundamental.


Para Anos Finais do Ensino Fundamental e Ensino Médio, os portadores de diploma de Licenciatura Plena em um dos componentes curriculares da BNCC.


No caso específico do componente curricular de Educação Física, a abertura de contrato está vinculada somente aos habilitados e à apresentação do registro no Conselho Regional de Educação Física - CREF.


Qualificação


Para Anos Finais do Ensino Fundamental e Ensino Médio:

a) portadores de diploma de licenciatura plena, independentemente da existência de 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos na disciplina a ser atribuída, desde que esta seja da mesma área do conhecimento;

b) portadores de diploma de Licenciatura Curta, na área de formação acadêmica ou disciplina a ser atribuída;

c) estudantes de Licenciatura Plena, desde que apresente 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos da disciplina a ser atribuída, identificada pelo histórico do curso;

d) portadores de diploma de Bacharel ou de Tecnólogo de nível superior, desde que apresente 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos, na área de conhecimento ou disciplina a ser atribuída, identificada pelo histórico do curso;

e) estudantes de Bacharelado ou de Tecnologia de nível superior, desde que apresente 160 (cento e sessenta) horas de estudos na área de conhecimento ou disciplina a ser atribuída, identificada pelo histórico do curso.


Inclusão e igualdade de oportunidades


Com o objetivo de promover a inclusão e a igualdade de oportunidades, o presente processo dará especial atenção para candidatos que integrem grupos historicamente marginalizados (por exemplo: pessoas com deficiência – PcD −, indígenas, mulheres, negros, pessoas incluídas no acrônimo LGBTQIAPN+, idosos.

  • Validation Rule
  • Flow
  • Profile
  • Lightning Page
  • Role

  • Declarative Tools: Expertise in using Salesforce's declarative tools for customization.

title: Engenheiros de IA
description:
Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.

Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.

Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Pleno
description:
Como Desenvolvedor(a) Java Pleno na Sankhya, você atuará na tribo ERP Logística, contribuindo diretamente para a evolução e sustentação de sistemas críticos utilizados por grandes clientes. Essa frente é estratégica para a companhia, com forte exposição a demandas regulatórias, operacionais e ao relacionamento com áreas como Produto, Qualidade e PMO.


Você fará parte de um time que atua em manutenção de sistemas legados, propondo melhorias, identificando falhas e colaborando com a categorização e resolução de ordens de serviço (OS), com foco em performance, estabilidade e ganho de conhecimento funcional. Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora com visão de qualidade e espírito colaborativo, que além de codar, também se preocupe em testar, automatizar, validar e garantir a robustez das entregas. Este papel tem responsabilidade dupla: desenvolver e garantir a excelência técnica nas liberações, atuando de forma híbrida entre Dev e QA.



RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Desenvolver e manter funcionalidades de software com foco em qualidade, desempenho, manutenibilidade e experiência do usuário;
  • Participar da análise e interpretação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais, colaborando com times de Produto, Qualidade e QA desde as fases iniciais;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, organizado e aderente aos padrões técnicos da Sankhya;
  • Realizar manutenção corretiva, evolutiva e adaptativa em sistemas e rotinas existentes;
  • Investigar e corrigir erros, propondo melhorias com foco em performance, estabilidade e prevenção de falhas;
  • Colaborar com a automação de testes e validação técnica das entregas, contribuindo para a robustez das versões liberadas;
  • Apoiar o time na definição de critérios de aceite, estratégias de teste e validação de cenários críticos;
  • Participar da definição de estimativas de esforço e planos de entrega, com visão integrada entre desenvolvimento e qualidade;
  • Atuar ativamente nos ritos ágeis do time (como dailies, plannings, reviews e retrospectivas), promovendo uma cultura de melhoria contínua;
  • Registrar e manter documentação técnica clara das funcionalidades desenvolvidas ou modificadas;
  • Compartilhar conhecimento técnico, boas práticas e aprendizados com o time, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência e colaboração.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência consolidada como Desenvolvedor(a) Pleno(a), atuando em sistemas de média ou alta complexidade;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Java (com foco em orientação a objetos);
  • Conhecimentos nas principais API Java (java.util, java.util.stream, java.time, java.util.concurrent).
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis em frameworks de font-end como AngularJS ou React, além de HTML, CSS e JavaScript;
  • Familiaridade com banco de dados relacional como por exemplo: SQL Server e Oracle (consultas, tuning, modelagem e estrutura relacional);
  • Escrita de consultas avançadas (JOINs, índices) e análise de planos de execução
  • Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando GIT;
  • Desejável vivência com frameworks como Spring, JPA e aplicação de design patterns;
  • Interesse ou experiência prática em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD);
  • Conhecimento em testes unitários e ferramentas para sua implementação como por exemplo (JUnit e Mockito).
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e suas ferramentas (Robot Framework, CyPress, Postman).
  • Conhecimento em escrita de testes usando ferramentas como gherkin.
  • Mentalidade de qualidade: valorizamos profissionais que consideram a excelência técnica desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega, com atenção a performance, cobertura de testes e prevenção de bugs.


Localidade | Atuação

Uberlândia/MG: Presencial

São Paulo/SP: Híbrido (2x na semana no escritório)

Demais localidades: Remoto

▪️ Regime de contratação CLT

Benefícios que vão além da Jornada Sankher

Na Sankhya, valorizamos a individualidade e acreditamos em proporcionar benefícios que vão além do básico, promovendo a liberdade e o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Nosso objetivo é oferecer todo o apoio necessário para que você se sinta bem e satisfeito em todas as áreas da sua vida.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
The company and our mission:


Zartis is a digital solutions provider working across technology strategy, software engineering and product development.


We partner with firms across financial services, MedTech, media, logistics technology, renewable energy, EdTech, e-commerce, and more. Our engineering hubs in EMEA and LATAM are full of talented professionals delivering business success and digital improvement across application development, software architecture, CI/CD, business intelligence, QA automation, and new technology integrations.


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on a project in the modern healthcare industry.


The project:


You will be joining the Booking team, contributing to a platform that simplifies healthcare appointment scheduling for millions of patients and providers. In this role, you’ll help shape how key information - such as insurance details - is collected and validated, ensuring a seamless booking journey.


Your work will center on evolving data models, improving system performance, and strengthening the reliability of a high-volume booking system. By collaborating with experienced engineers, you’ll extend and optimize microservices in the booking domain, driving scalability, cost efficiency, and stability. This is an opportunity to apply deep technical expertise while making a meaningful impact in a distributed, innovation-driven environment.


What you will do:


- Building large-scale APIs and microservices, creating frictionless data flows that empower both patients and providers to access care and information in real time.

- Mentoring fellow engineers, supercharging team throughput through robust coding standards, automated workflows, and a culture of continuous improvement.

- Spearheading bold innovation, whether it’s adopting generative AI, exploring emerging data sources, or pioneering architectural strategies that keep the platform ahead in healthcare tech.

- Decomposing complex product challenges to drive sound design decisions.

- Collaborating with an agile team of engineers, product managers, and designers.

- Working with cutting-edge GenAI tools and technology.


What you will bring:


- Inspiration to positively impact the healthcare experience of millions of patients and providers.

- A product-driven mindset with relentless focus on user needs.

- Strong autonomy, accountability, and comfort in a remote-first environment.

- Passion for engineering fundamentals and promoting best practices in code health, testing, and maintainability.

- Commitment to fostering diverse and inclusive teams and culture.

- Entrepreneurial spirit with strong ownership, thriving in fast-changing and ambiguous environments.

- Ability to craft database schemas, implement REST APIs, and design event-driven queue and stream processing systems, ideally with C#, .NET Core, and AWS.

- A history of solid and well-rounded system design skills.

- Leadership by example in testing, deployment, and observability practices.

- Excellent communication skills: able to dive into technical detail with engineers while presenting clear solutions to non-technical audiences.

- Comfort working with distributed teams.

- Experience integrating generative AI tools into daily workflows to automate tasks, drive innovation, and maximize productivity.


What we offer:


- 100% Remote Work.

- WFH allowance: Monthly

title: Project Accountant
description:
Role Purpose


The Project Accountant is a finance professional responsible for managing the financial control of strategic projects, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely reporting. This role requires not only technical expertise in project accounting but also strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with project teams, auditors, and international colleagues in a multicultural environment.


⸻


Core Responsibilities


• Financial Control & Compliance

• Maintain financial control over project accounts and ensure compliance with company policies and contractual terms.

• Support compliance with audit requirements and contractual obligations.

• Identify project-related risks and recommend mitigation strategies.


• Reporting & Deliverables

• Prepare monthly and quarterly financial reports, including cash flow statements and 17-week rolling forecasts .

• Calculate and monitor Percentage of Completion (POC) for revenue recognition under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

• Deliver accurate financial insights for decision-making, including variance analysis and project profitability.

• Prepare and monitor hedge calculations , manage multi-currency exposures, and advise on hedging needs.

• Ensure high-quality reporting standards with clear ownership of accuracy and completeness.


• Collaboration & Insights

• Work closely with project management, cost control, procurement, subcontracting, and planning teams to align financial data with operational activities.

• Translate operational progress into accurate financial impacts, including engineering team mobilization, project management teams, and marine vessel schedules .

• Interface with planners to ensure the timely and correct reflection of project milestones and costs.

• Serve as a key interface with internal stakeholders, auditors, and client representatives.


• Business Development & Bids

• Support the analysis of new bids and tenders , with particular focus on cash flow projections and financial feasibility.

• Provide insights to management on the potential financial risks and returns of new projects.


⸻


Key Qualifications


• Experience: Minimum of 5 years preferably in oil & gas, EPCI, or construction industries.

• Education: Degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or Engineering.


• Technical Skills:

• Advanced Excel and strong ERP system knowledge.

• Solid understanding of POC revenue recognition, hedge accounting, and multi-currency project environments.

• Languages: Advanced to fluent in English & Portuguese.

• Soft Skills:

• Strong communication skills to effectively liaise with multicultural, international teams.

• Ability to work independently with ownership of deliverables and accountability for report quality.

• Analytical, proactive, and solutions-oriented profile.

title: Médico Endocrinologista (RQE)
description:
*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO ENDOCRINOLOGISTA (com RQE) NA TELADOC HEALTH"


Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!


A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicas e Médicos Especialistas em Endocrinologia! Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.


*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: *


A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na modalidade de consultas de especialidade em Endocrinologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos;


DESCRIÇÃO DAS ATIVIDADES:



  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Endocrinologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endocrinológicos .


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de conduzir anamnese virtual para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de risco e gravidade em Endocrinologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças Endocrinológicas .


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca dos principais problemas de saúde em Endocrinologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.


REQUISITOS


Formação Acadêmica:

  • Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA
  • Obrigatório: RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO EM ENDOCRINOLOGIA


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista - RQE (emitido pelo Conselho respectivo) em Endocrinologia ;
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil).


Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Endocrinologia , sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;


Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios Endócrinos e metabólicos..


Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.


Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.


Local de Trabalho:

REMOTO



IMPORTANTE:


MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO: Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo.


REMUNERAÇÃO E AGENDAMENTOS : a negociar durante processo seletivo.


Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Endocrinologia.

title: Lead Engineer
description:
Position Title: Lead Engineer

Organization Description : JUMP Math is a Canadian charity with global reach that empowers teachers and educators to multiply the potential in every classroom through research-informed, curriculum-aligned resources and approaches that ignite and nurture an enduring understanding and love of math in every student. For more information:


Position Summary :


JUMP Math is a Canadian-based registered charity and social enterprise with a bold mission to inspire a love of mathematics in students and help them achieve their full potential. Our evidence-based approach and innovative Preschool to Grade 9 resources and pedagogy empowers teachers and students to build confidence, increase engagement, and master essential math skills. At JUMP Math, we believe that everyone can succeed in math, and we are committed to making a lasting impact in classrooms across the globe. As an organization, we pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment where every team member is motivated by the shared goal of transforming math education.


As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a dynamic and skilled Lead Engineer with product and technology expertise and experience in project delivery to help lead our various technology and content digitization efforts. If you are passionate about making a real difference and want to contribute to a mission-driven organization that is changing the world, JUMP Math is the place for you.


As a Lead Engineer, you will be a hands-on technical leader responsible for building, reviewing, and maintaining the core systems of the JUMP Math platform. You will ensure that both our application and AI engine are robust, scalable, and maintainable. You will lead and collaborate closely with the engineering team, providing technical guidance, mentoring, and ensuring the team is aligned and effective. You will also work closely with Product and Design to drive the platform forward.


This is a full-time role (37.5 hours/week).


Location of Work: This candidate for this role must be residing in Brazil and is intended to be remote.


Key Accountabilities:

  • Own and deliver high-quality code across the full stack (frontend, backend, and AI integration)
  • Lead and mentor a development team, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment
  • Conduct code reviews and maintain coding standards to ensure maintainability and reliability
  • Manage DevOps tasks including deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, monitoring, and scaling
  • Design and implement APIs, and integrate with third-party services
  • Ensure security, performance, and reliability of the platform in production environments
  • Troubleshoot and resolve critical technical issues across the stack and optimize code
  • Participate in architecture decisions and recommend improvements to the platform design
  • Collaborate with the Machine Learning team to integrate AI question generation and scaffolding into the platform
  • Contribute to defining accessibility standards and compliance (data protection, privacy, and security in educational environments)
  • Coordinate with distributed teams across different time zones, ensuring clear and efficient communication


Skills:

  • Skilled in code review, system architecture, and software best practices
  • Proficiency in backend languages and frontend frameworks
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, leadership and collaboration skills
  • High level of Spanish and English
  • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Familiarity with Generative AI (Chat GPT, Prompting, APIs, Fine-tuning) and Machine Learning algorithms (Python)


Personal Attributes:

  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Proactive and adaptable to a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Commitment to social mission and inclusive education


Education and Experience (minimums):

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with full-stack development
  • Strong experience in DevOps / cloud infrastructure (AWS, CI/CD pipelines)
  • Experience in projects using PHP (Laravel), React.JS, Next.JS
  • Knowledge of data security and regulatory compliance (GDPR, FERPA, or other relevant frameworks)
  • Experience with databases (eg. MySQL, MariaDB, Supabase, MongoDB), caching, and API design
  • Experience integrating AI/ML models into production applications
  • Experience leading distributed or remote teams
  • Basic knowledge of web accessibility (WCAG) and inclusive UX practices


To Apply :


Qualified candidates may apply on or before October 3, 2025, to with a cover letter and resume. Please include position title in subject line of email. Please use the cover letter to explain in one page how your qualifications match our requirements and why this job is right for you at this point in your career.


We thank all applicants for their interest. Qualified candidates will be interviewed as applications are received until a suitable candidate is hired. Only those considered for an interview will be contacted. No phone calls please.


JUMP Math is committed to diversity within its community and especially welcomes applications from racialized persons/persons of colour, women, Indigenous/Aboriginal people of North America, persons with disabilities, LGBTQ persons, and others who may contribute to further diversification of ideas.   • work experience.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Mútua


Mútua is an AI-powered platform that bridges mission-driven funders—from philanthropic to commercial—with innovators across sectors, from startups to NGOs. By aligning capital with high-impact solutions in essential systems like food & land use, energy, education, and healthcare, Mútua increases decision-making accuracy for funders and empowers innovators to access critical resources. Our technology unlocks untapped potential by transforming fragmented impact data into actionable intelligence, driving transformational impact across geographies and systems.


The Role

We are looking for a proactive, hands-on, and purpose-driven AI Engineer to strengthen our product and consulting solutions. You’ll be at the forefront of applying Large Language Models (LLMs) , RAG , and AI agents to solve real-world challenges in impact investing. In this role, you’ll begin with a strategic project to develop Mútua’s conversational interface , a cornerstone of our product experience. This will serve as your entry point into a broader journey of scaling our AI methodologies across the platform. You’ll work closely with our CTO and benefit from the premium technical support and Skills Boost access provided by Google through our grant.


What You’ll Do
  • Design, test, and deploy prompt engineering and prompt chaining workflows in collaboration with the business and product teams.
  • Implement and refine RAG pipelines to combine structured and unstructured data for better discovery and recommendations.
  • Define and execute model evaluation strategies to benchmark LLMs and ensure reliability.
  • Develop human-in-the-loop systems that balance automation with expert oversight.
  • Explore and deploy AI agents to support discovery, classification, and recommendation workflows.
  • Collaborate with both the core product team and the Systems Intelligence Services team on high-value consulting projects that integrate back into our platform.


We’re Looking For
  • 2+ years of experience working directly with LLMs (development, deployment, or applied research).
  • Strong knowledge of prompt engineering and hands-on experience with conversational AI.
  • Experience with RAG , model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop pipelines.
  • Use workflow automation/orchestration tools (e.g. n8n, LangChain, or similar) to structure and scale prompt chaining and LLM pipelines.
  • Bonus: experience with Google Vertex AI or AI Studio .
  • Strong problem-solving mindset, able to move from concept to working prototype in short cycles.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable in a flexible, fully remote, task-based environment.
  • Fluent in English
  • Passion for building technologies that drive systemic social and environmental impact.


Why Mútua?
  • Competitive early-stage compensation with clear pathway to equity (stock options).
  • Fully remote, flexible, and outcome-oriented work environment.
  • Opportunity to consolidate your career as an AI Engineer working on the frontier of LLM applications.
  • Direct access to Google experts and resources , thanks to our $250k grant.
  • A collaborative, mission-driven culture that values growth, learning, and innovation.


Join us at Mútua

Be part of a team pioneering essential infrastructure for the global impact ecosystem, while building your career at the cutting edge of applied AI.

title: Remote Digital Operations Coordinator
description:
Hiring: Remote Digital Operations Coordinator (Technical Operations Specialist )

Company: Copy Squad

Reports to: CEO/Owner

Status: FULL-TIME / CONTRACT

Location: Remote


Position Overview

Do you love building systems that make everything run smoother?


Are you energized by automation, tech integrations, and streamlining workflows across multiple brands?


Do you thrive behind the scenes, keeping operations tight while freeing up creative leaders to stay in their zone of genius?


Then Copy Squad wants you on the team.


About The Company

We’re hiring a Remote Digital Operations Coordinator / Technical Operations Specialist to serve as an integrator across three brands, Copy Squad, PickJunkies, and our agency division. In this role, you’ll work directly with the CEO to build and maintain automations, streamline onboarding, organize creative assets, and analyze performance data. Your contributions will form the operational backbone of the business, enabling the creative team to stay focused on strategy and growth.


Copy Squad is a boutique agency that helps businesses scale through direct-response copywriting and strategic marketing. We specialize in high-converting funnels, email campaigns, and sales pages that deliver measurable results. Our culture values autonomy, clarity, and execution. We’re lean, agile, and driven by outcomes, not fluff.

This role is ideal for someone who is tech-savvy, proactive, and thrives on solving operational challenges. If you’re energized by creating systems, managing complexity, and turning ideas into action, you’ll fit right in.


Learn more about the company HERE.


Responsibilities

  • Build and manage automations in GoHighLevel (tags, triggers, email/SMS sequences, upsell/downsell flows)
  • Automate cross-sell and upsell campaigns (e.g., lifetime pass offers triggered post-purchase)
  • Integrate fulfillment extras (e.g., Printify t-shirt delivery) into automation stack
  • Maintain and optimize onboarding sequences from purchase → Discord → product access
  • Simplify onboarding for less tech-savvy users with walkthroughs and explainer videos
  • Maintain a centralized swipe file system for copywriters (Notion-based)
  • Organize and distribute high-performing promos, emails, and ads for easy access if requested by writers.
  • Use GoHighLevel API or integrations to track email performance (open/click rates)
  • Gather top-performing client promos and store them for internal use
  • Maintain templated assets for junior-level tasks (order forms, upsells, offers)
  • Ensure funnels (opt-ins, follow-ups, upsells) are running and optimized
  • Implement upsell triggers and fulfillment automation
  • Act as an ops partner across all brands, tying together tech, customer experience, and internal processes
  • Take over low-leverage tasks currently handled by the CEO and design lead
  • Focus first 30/60/90 days on agency swipe system, PickJunkies onboarding, and Copy Squad automations


Requirements

  • Exceptional fluency in English across reading, writing, and verbal communication
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in digital marketing or a similar agency environment (preferred)
  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with automations, integrations, and system optimization
  • Minimum 2 years of project management experience using PM tools (e.g., ClickUp, Asana—not ticketing platforms)
  • Leadership experience in managing teams or cross-functional projects (preferred)
  • Familiarity with copywriting and marketing funnels (preferred)
  • Strong technical aptitude; comfortable working with automation platforms and digital tools
  • Proven ability to identify inefficiencies and implement long-term, scalable solutions
  • Skilled in breaking down complex projects into clear, actionable steps
  • Capable of making sound decisions independently and managing multiple priorities


Additional requirements:

  • Available to work in U.S. EST time zones
  • Access to a computer and basic tech setup
  • Reliable internet connection
  • Reliable and distraction-free work environment
  • Financial industry knowledge is helpful
  • Project Management tool experience with Notion or similar software, highly preferred (Not ticketing tools like Jira)


This position is for a person who is:

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Strong follow-through and task completion skills
  • Proactive self-starter who takes initiative without needing micromanagement
  • Operates with a sense of urgency and accountability
  • Comfortable being direct and assertive, especially around deadlines
  • Professional and composed in fast-paced environments
  • Solution-oriented with a positive, can-do attitude
  • Takes ownership and avoids excuses
  • Motivated by impact and loves getting things done


This position is NOT for someone who:

  • Struggles with follow-through or self-management
  • Has to be pushed to do their job
  • Prefers a slow-paced work environment
  • Lacks a sense of urgency
  • Thinks “good enough is good enough”
  • Makes excuses
  • Doesn’t care about getting exceptional results
  • Is unavailable to work during U.S. EST time zone
  • Can’t stand political conservative viewpoints
  • Hates the financial industry


Software Utilized by Company

GoHighLevel, Notion, Google Workspace, Printify


Offer Details

  • Full-time, remote, contractor position
  • BRL: R$6.720,00 - BRL: R$7.280,00/month
  • No benefits provided


Our Cultural Pillars :

  • We are professionals. We get the job done, done right, and done on time.
  • We deliver high-quality work.
  • We are efficient but not frenetic.
  • We use systems and processes to stay on task and finish on time.
  • We do not make excuses.


Interview Process :

To better allow you to display your skills and to help us determine the best candidates, our recruiting process is approximately four to five weeks and takes place in four rounds:

  • Initial Application
  • Skills Application
  • Live interview with our recruiting agency
  • Final interview with CEO or manager

If selected, you will be invited by email to progress to the next round.

  • Adaptabilidade: Flexibilidade para se ajustar a mudanças e novos desafios em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução.
  • Colaboração: Habilidade de trabalhar efetivamente em equipe, promovendo um ambiente de apoio e troca de ideias.

Desejáveis:

  • Noções de acessibilidade digital (WCAG).
  • Vivência em projetos ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experiência no mercado financeiro é um diferencial que valorizamos.

Ele convida indústrias a proporem projetos de Pesquisa, Desenvolvimento e Inovação (PD&I) nos quais a participação dos bolsistas promova o crescimento profissional em PD&I empresarial e contribua para a inovação da empresa. O programa oferece bolsas para graduandos, graduados, mestres e doutores, permitindo atividades de PD&I nas instalações das empresas pelo território nacional, após aprovação da Comissão Interna do IEL Paraná.


Projeto: Futuro da Beleza - Vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans)


Sobre a Oportunidade:

No Grupo Boticário, acreditamos que inovar é conectar hoje com o amanhã. O projeto tem como propósito apoiar a equipe de Inovação Estratégica de Produtos na estratégia do projeto Futuro da Beleza, identificando as rotas tecnológicas de produto mais promissoras para os próximos anos. Nosso objetivo é traduzir tendências em oportunidades concretas, transformando ciência e tecnologia em valor para milhões de consumidores.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de explorar territórios de inovação já mapeados, caracterizar e quantificar rotas tecnológicas a partir da análise de ICTs, empresas e startups, além de colaborar com áreas estratégicas como marketing, foresight, categoria (embalagem e formulação) e pesquisa.

O resultado esperado é a conexão entre a estratégia de inovação de curto prazo e as de médio e longo prazo, garantindo maior eficiência na identificação de oportunidades tecnológicas em PD&I. Se você tem perfil analítico, curiosidade para explorar novas fronteiras da ciência e vontade de gerar impacto real no futuro da beleza, que desejam cocriar conosco o amanhã da beleza.

Essa vaga afirmativa é para talentos diversos — Pessoa com Deficiência, Pessoas Negras (pretas e pardas), Pessoas 45+, Comunidade LGBTQI+ e Mulheres (Cis e Trans).

  • Fazer a análise crítica dos dados obtidos e cruzar com estratégia de inovação do Grupo Boticário.
  • Caracterizar as rotas tecnológicas identificadas de acordo com metodologia pré-definida.
  • Calibrar pesquisa com consumidores e realizar consolidação do material e análise crítica dos resultados.
  • Construir a apresentação do relatório final.


Conhecimento necessário:

  • Capacidade analítica para interpretar os dados obtidos e conectá-los com os relatórios estratégicos obtidos e liderados por outras áreas do Grupo Boticário;
  • Curiosidade e proatividade na busca por informações;

title: Compliance Specialist
description:
Compliance Specialist

We are seeking a remote, full-time SOC 2 Compliance Specialist with expertise in SaaS environments and proficiency in using compliance management platforms (preferably Vanta). The ideal candidate will lead the client's SOC 2 compliance efforts, streamline evidence collection, ensure continuous monitoring, and support security and compliance programs to meet industry standards and customer expectations.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, enhance grid health, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • SOC 2 Compliance Management : Lead the end-to-end process for achieving and maintaining SOC 2 compliance, including scoping, evidence collection, control implementation, and audit preparation using Vanta's platform
  • Vanta Platform Utilization : Leverage Vanta's AI and automation tools to streamline compliance workflows, monitor controls, and manage vendor risk assessments
  • Continuous Monitoring : Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)
  • Policy Development : Develop, update, and maintain security and compliance policies, procedures, and documentation within Vantas' centralized platform
  • Vendor Risk Management : Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support : Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations
  • Training and Awareness : Conduct training sessions for employees on SOC 2 compliance requirements and best practices for maintaining a secure SaaS environment
  • Reporting and Metrics : Use Vanta's reporting features to track compliance metrics, generate reports, and communicate the company's security posture to internal stakeholders and external clients
  • Stay Updated : Keep abreast of evolving compliance frameworks, security standards, and Vanta platform updates to ensure alignment with industry best practices


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 3+ years of experience in compliance, information security, or risk management, with a focus on SOC 2 compliance in a SaaS environment
  • Hands-on experience with Vanta or similar compliance automation platforms
  • Proven track record of successfully managing SOC 2 audits and implementing controls
  • Strong understanding of SaaS architecture, cloud security, and data privacy principles
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or NIST CSF
  • Proficiency in using compliance automation platforms for evidence collection, continuous monitoring, and vendor risk management
  • Excellent project management and organizational skills to manage complex compliance initiatives
  • Strong communication skills to liaise with technical teams, auditors, and leadership
  • Detail-oriented with a proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or SOC 2-specific training)
  • Familiarity with Vanta's AI Agent and other advanced features for GRC automation.
  • Experience working with startups, mid-market, or enterprise organizations in a SaaS environment
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Managers of Information Technology, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!


Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!


The Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT. The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first, environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.


You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.


You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.


About the Role

  • You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • We’re all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise.
  • You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.
  • You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
  • You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.
  • You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.
  • You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)
  • You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.
  • You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.
  • You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).
  • You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.


What You Bring to Ledn:

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time poor without losing your cool.
  • You write very well, whether it’s in tickets, email or Slack. You write in a clear, friendly, and concise manner, and are sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone’s time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.


Nice to Haves:

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command-line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.


Culture Fit:

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will:

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.


A Taste of What We Provide:

  • As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.


We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.


Ledn Working Environment

Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Técnico de manutenção
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Técnico de Manutenção, você irá:


  • Ser responsável pela manutenção corretiva e preventiva, assim como solucionar os problemas diários de Guindastes;
  • Reportar e dar feedback a Sany periodicamente sobre todas as falhas e trabalhos realizados;
  • Concluir as orientações técnica e outros trabalhos emitidos pelo departamento comercial ou conforme necessidade da Sany;
  • Manter um bom relacionamento com clientes, representantes e colaboradores;
  • Elaborar relatório de Diagnóstico de falhas.


Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:


  • Ter concluído o ensino técnico em Mecânica, Elétrica, Eletrônica ou áreas afins;
  • Ter experiência com manutenção em Guindastes.


Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Vale Refeição
  • Transporte
  • Crédito Consignado
  • Ticket Mês Aniversário

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
AI Engineer – Data & Automation (Healthcare SaaS)


About Us

AMX Healthcare is building a new SaaS platform to transform how healthcare staffing is managed—connecting clients, contractors, and job opportunities with speed and compliance. We’re investing in AI to streamline recruiting, automate data flows, and surface insights from our knowledge base (resumes, job descriptions, Confluence, ATS/CRM, etc.).


Role Overview

We’re hiring an AI Engineer – Data & Automation to design and build intelligent systems that bring structure, insight, and automation to our staffing workflows. You’ll turn unstructured data (resumes, job descriptions, documents, chats) into actionable intelligence using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) , document intelligence , and structured extraction . This is a founding role to develop and own the AI function —defining architecture, best practices, and solutions that become foundational for our platform and business.


The Impact

  • Time-to-fill ↓ 30–50%: OCR → parse → validate → post cuts manual touches from hours to minutes.
  • Zero-drama compliance: Primary-source checks, expirations, and audit logs built in.
  • Revenue & margin ↑: Accurate pay-package math and cleaner timesheets reduce adjustments/write-offs.
  • Cash flow ↑: Invoice creation from approved time, automated AR, and payroll sync reduce DSO and billing errors.
  • Recruiter capacity ↑: AI SMS cadences and clean data flows speed shortlists and follow-through.
  • Decision speed: Live Sheets/Excel/Power BI replaces weekly spreadsheet marathons.
  • Platform rigor: MLOps, observability, and cost governance keep AI stable, safe, and affordable.


What You’ll Build

  • Document AI pipelines: OCR → classify → extract → validate → post for licenses, immunizations, I-9s, background checks, timesheets, and offers. Enforce strict JSON schemas, confidence scores, and text-span provenance.
  • Compliance automation: Primary-source license checks, date/format rules, name/DOB matching, immunization logic, and timesheet math (REG/OT).
  • Workflow integrations: Event-driven APIs/webhooks across Applicant Tracking Systems , healthcare compliance platforms , job boards , CRM/Marketing systems (e.g., HubSpot or Salesforce ), and Task Management Tools (e.g., Jira, Zoom Tasks).
  • Text message (SMS) automation: AI-assisted campaigns and cadences (opt-in, nurture, reactivation) triggered from ATS/CRM events; personalize copy, schedule sends, ingest replies/MMS docs, and auto-log to the system of record.
  • Comms → system of record: Integrate VoIP/SMS (e.g., RingCentral, TextUs, BeeTexting) with ATS/Compliance to auto-log activity, attach files, and trigger workflows.
  • Customer support & knowledge base automation: Zendesk + knowledge base workflows—AI triage/routing, macro suggestions, agent-assist via RAG with citations, chatbot deflection, and SLA dashboards.
  • Marketing & CMS automation: Content workflows with Jasper AI ; landing/job content in HubSpot CMS , Webflow , or WordPress .
  • Pay package automation: Bill rates + stipends + guaranteed hours → weekly packages with audit trails.
  • Finance, accounting & payroll automation (required): Integrations with QuickBooks Online or Xero and payroll tools to:
  • Generate invoices from approved time, bill rates, and contract terms; handle credits/adjustments.
  • Sync AR/AP, post journal entries, reconcile payments; surface exceptions for review.
  • Automate payroll prep from timesheets and pay packages; route exceptions to HITL queues with full auditability.
  • Knowledge assistants: RAG chatbots over Confluence/SharePoint/Drive/ATS/CRM with permissions, citations, and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Live reporting: Streams to Google Sheets , Excel , and Power BI for exceptions, credential heatmaps, ready-to-work rosters, AR aging, and payroll variance.


MLOps & Platform

  • Dataset/prompt/embedding versioning; golden test sets; offline/online evals; A/B tests.
  • CI/CD for data and models; rollbacks; feature flags; latency/reliability SLOs; canary/blue-green.
  • Durable orchestration and state (idempotency, retries/backoff, dead-letter handling).
  • Observability (traces/metrics/cost), drift detection, PII/HIPAA redaction, RBAC, audit logs.
  • Cost governance: token/throughput controls, caching/TTL, embedding reuse, batching, FinOps reporting.


Must-Have

  • Strong software engineering in Python and/or C# .
  • Hands-on LLM/RAG (embeddings, retrieval, prompt design, evaluation).

title: Controller
description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing restaurant group based in the United States, focused on delivering high-quality dining experiences and operating with strong financial discipline. Our locations serve thousands of guests every week, and we are committed to excellence in both customer experience and operational performance.

The company has expanded steadily over the past several years, and we are preparing for continued growth. With multiple concepts and locations under management, we need a Controller who can help build the financial systems, processes, and reporting that will support us as we scale.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Controller to oversee accounting and financial operations across our restaurant group. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate financial reporting, implementing strong controls, and supporting decision-making with timely analysis. You’ll work closely with the leadership team to manage budgets, streamline processes, and provide insights that improve profitability.

This is a hands-on position where you’ll both manage the numbers day-to-day and help design the systems that will carry the company forward.


What You’ll Do

  • Oversee all accounting operations, including A/P, A/R, payroll, and general ledger
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements
  • Manage cash flow, budgets, and forecasts to support company growth
  • Ensure compliance with tax filings, audits, and regulatory requirements
  • Implement and improve accounting systems, policies, and procedures
  • Partner with operations leadership to track restaurant performance and profitability
  • Provide detailed financial analysis and reporting to guide business decisions


What We’re Looking For

  • Careful attention to detail and accuracy in financial work
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive mindset—able to spot issues early and propose solutions
  • Clear communicator, both written and spoken
  • Strong knowledge of accounting systems (QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar)
  • Proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets for financial modeling and reporting
  • Collaborative approach to working with operations and leadership teams


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • Valid registration with the CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade) in Brazil (Contador habilitado)
  • At least 5–7 years of professional experience in accounting/finance, ideally including restaurant, hospitality, or retail sector experience
  • Strong knowledge of full-cycle accounting, financial reporting, and internal controls
  • Experience with U.S. GAAP or IFRS reporting standards
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets for financial modeling and reporting
  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken)


Preferred

  • U.S. CPA license or progress toward CPA certification
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies, subsidiaries, or international operations


Software Experience

  • Microsoft Office: must have
  • Quickbooks Online: Strong preference
  • Toast: Nice to have


Growth Potential

This role offers the opportunity to help shape the financial foundation of a growing restaurant group. As the company expands, the Controller will play a key role in building out the finance function.

title: Analista de Negócios
description:
Somos a primeira franquia de marketplace do Brasil, uma startup pré-seed com menos de 1 ano de operação, mas já crescendo de forma acelerada. Estamos construindo um modelo inovador e único, com uma cultura forte, colaborativa e focada em resultados. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de aprender muito na prática sobre e-commerce, logística, importação e negociação, e crescer em um ambiente dinâmico e cheio de desafios.


Estamos procurando um Gestor de Lojas para integrar o nosso Departamento de Gestão de Lojas. Essa pessoa será responsável por administrar de forma completa 2 a 3 lojas de marketplace de franqueados, garantindo performance, organização e transparência com o investidor da loja.


SUAS RESPONSABILIDADES:


-Gerenciamento de anúncios (preço, descrição, promoções, publicidade, etc.).


-Gestão de importações (recomendar recompras na China para repor estoque).


-Comunicação diária com a empresa de logística responsável por despacho e armazenamento.


-Gestão da reputação das lojas, solucionando problemas pontuais.


-Análise de custos, rentabilidade e fluxo de caixa (a receber, a pagar, despesas recorrentes, relatórios de margens).


-Comunicação rotineira com o franqueado investidor, entregando relatórios de performance (anúncios, estoque, financeiro).


-Criação de ferramentas e automações. Buscando tornar sua rotina cada vez mais eficiênte.


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:


-Visão de negócios e senso de dono: olhar além da execução, buscando sempre melhorar a performance da loja.


-Organização e disciplina para lidar com múltiplas demandas.


-Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, para interações com logística, fornecedores e franqueados.


-Raciocínio analítico para interpretar dados e criar relatórios úteis.


-Resolução de problemas com proatividade e agilidade.


-Gestão de tempo para dividir a atenção entre diferentes lojas e diferentes tarefas.


-Excel/planilhas em nível intermediário.


-Inglês funcional.


-Abertura para aprender muito, já que todo nosso modelo será ensinado internamente.


DIFERENCIAIS COMPETITIVOS:


-Alta capacidade lógica e analítica (logic-driven thinking).


-Excel avançado (fórmulas avançadas, VBA, dashboards).


-Uso eficaz de ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial.


-Experiência prévia em e-commerce/marketplaces (Mercado Livre, Amazon, Shopee).


-Conhecimento em programação (Python é um plus).


-Experiência com bancos de dados (SQL) e APIs.


-Experiência em finanças empresariais (fluxo de caixa, margem de contribuição, indicadores).


-Organização acima da média e visão comercial proativa.


-Experiência em análise de concorrência e tendências de mercado.

*Horário: Comercial, de segunda a sexta.*

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a People Operations Specialist to join our growing global HR team. This role will be an Individual Contributor (IC) position, focused on managing core People Ops activities and supporting employees across multiple regions. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter, detail-oriented, and collaborative professional with experience in global organizations and the ability to work across time zones.


Key Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end People Operations processes across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and other employment changes.
  • Provide support to employees and stakeholders globally, ensuring consistent and seamless People Operations across regions.
  • Maintain and update HR systems (primarily HiBob, with exposure to Microsoft Office and HRIS tools) to ensure accurate employee records and reporting.
  • Partner with hiring managers and global HR peers to deliver guidance, promote best practices, and ensure compliance with internal policies.
  • Handle confidential employee data with the highest level of discretion, accuracy, and compliance with data privacy requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve HR processes, streamline workflows, and enhance communication throughout the employee lifecycle.
  • Contribute to employee engagement initiatives, helping foster cultural alignment and connection within a distributed workforce.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in HR/People Operations, ideally in a tech or fast-paced global organization.
  • Strong working knowledge of HR processes and compliance frameworks globally.
  • Hands-on experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., HiBob, Workday, Greenhouse, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across cultures and time zones.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining attention to detail.


Soft Skills

  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Problem-solving mindset with flexibility to adapt in a dynamic environment.
  • High level of integrity and confidentiality.


Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a fully remote role.
  • Exposure to global HR operations and cross-cultural teams.
  • Clear career growth opportunities within a scaling People Ops team.
  • Be part of a collaborative and supportive environment focused on innovation and impact.
